primary_endpoint: mean bits correct at 48 charged admissions
encoding: one planted bit per item, both axes set to that bit
policy: each round admits every item at the minimum absolute likelihood exponent; this chooses which item is next and does not change the channel
comparator: kernel expectation of that decoder, 100000 trials, seed 20261007, frozen in this file before the live run
secondary_endpoints: fraction of released axes unequal to the planted bit, expected 1/2
one post-budget filing is refused and does not move the decoder
analysis: (mean - exact_at_48) / (sample standard deviation / sqrt(64)), reported either way; no optional stopping and no replacement of a low or high result
not_claimed: This is a kernel and cap check. It is not a stronger adversary than the one-bit channel.
